methods.direct_method_finding: The packet's stream codec directly binds the packet write method and packet read constructor; packet ID mapping requires separate protocol registration evidence.
The sending constructor takes chunk X/Z from LevelChunk.getPos and builds one chunk-data object and one light-data object with the caller's section filters.
The direct write sequence is coordinate X, coordinate Z, chunkData.write, then lightData.write. Neither a block entity count nor light data may precede chunk data.

On receive, heightmaps decode first, then a VarInt section-byte count, then section bytes, then block-entity records. The direct method rejects counts above 2097152 but delegates VarInt underflow/negative handling.
On receive, light consumes the sky-present, block-present, empty-sky and empty-block bitsets in order, then sky and block update lists.

directly_supported_candidate_laws.statement: For this exact packet constructor/write pair, chunk X and Z are obtained from the same loaded chunk position, and the packet write method emits X, Z, chunk-data and then light-data fields in that order. Underlying writeInt scalar encoding is a separate delegate contract.

The chunk payload read constructor decodes the heightmap before the VarInt-framed section payload and block-entity list. Its explicit upper bound is 2,097,152 section bytes; lower-bound, overlong VarInt and nested decoding outcomes remain delegated.

The light-data read constructor decodes four ordered bitsets (sky-present, block-present, sky-empty, block-empty), then sky updates, then block updates; exact BitSet and data-layer encoding remain delegated.
